raw.query:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.window_name, c.lead_s, c.numerator_worker_seconds,
         c.denominator_worker_seconds, c.cost_ratio
  FROM provenance.v_dim d
  JOIN provenance.v_cost_ratio c ON c.run_id = d.run_id
  WHERE d.is_current = TRUE
    AND c.is_current = TRUE
    AND d.experiment = 'a2x'
    AND c.experiment = 'a2x'
    AND c.policy = 'forecast'
    AND c.lead_s IN (15, 30, 45, 165)
    AND c.denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8'
    AND c.denominator_window_mismatch = FALSE
), by_lead AS (
  SELECT lead_s, count(*) AS windows,
         sum(numerator_worker_seconds) / sum(denominator_worker_seconds) AS aggregate_cost_ratio,
         avg(cost_ratio) AS mean_window_cost_ratio
  FROM base
  GROUP BY lead_s
), endpoints AS (
  SELECT window_name,
         max(cost_ratio) FILTER (WHERE lead_s = 15) AS ratio_15,
         max(cost_ratio) FILTER (WHERE lead_s = 165) AS ratio_165
  FROM base
  GROUP BY window_name
), paired AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE ratio_15 IS NOT NULL AND ratio_165 IS NOT NULL) AS paired_windows,
         avg((ratio_15 - ratio_165) / ratio_15) FILTER (WHERE ratio_15 IS NOT NULL AND ratio_165 IS NOT NULL) AS mean_relative_drop_15_to_165,
         min((ratio_15 - ratio_165) / ratio_15) FILTER (WHERE ratio_15 IS NOT NULL AND ratio_165 IS NOT NULL) AS min_relative_drop_15_to_165,
         max((ratio_15 - ratio_165) / ratio_15) FILTER (WHERE ratio_15 IS NOT NULL AND ratio_165 IS NOT NULL) AS max_relative_drop_15_to_165
  FROM endpoints
)
SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
         'lead_s', lead_s,
         'windows', windows,
         'aggregate_cost_ratio', aggregate_cost_ratio,
         'mean_window_cost_ratio', mean_window_cost_ratio
       ) ORDER BY lead_s) AS lead_summary,
       paired_windows,
       mean_relative_drop_15_to_165,
       min_relative_drop_15_to_165,
       max_relative_drop_15_to_165
FROM by_lead CROSS JOIN paired
GROUP BY paired_windows, mean_relative_drop_15_to_165,
         min_relative_drop_15_to_165, max_relative_drop_15_to_165
